title: Book a time: a strip of days, the free times of the chosen day, taken ones greyed out
about: Appointments, lessons, calls, a court, a van or a person by the hour: bookings are rows with a start (and an end); the part offers each day's slots between opening and closing time and greys out the taken ones, so nothing is booked twice. With RESOURCE the person picks whom or what first (a staff member, a court) and only that one's bookings take its slots. The chosen slot opens the view that finishes the booking, or calls the rule that takes it (which refuses a clash with times_overlap).

key.about: names the pattern's data and state

start.about: the bookings column with the start ('YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM')

end.about: the bookings column with the end (optional)

closed.about: weekdays with no slots, 0 Sunday to 6 Saturday (a list)

days.about: how many days ahead are offered

resource.about: the bookings column naming whom or what is booked

resources.about: the table of those (to pick from)

label.about: the resources column with each one's name

view.about: the view a chosen slot opens with {start, end, resource}

call.about: the function a chosen slot calls with {start, end, resource}

{{key}}_who.$value: SELECT id, {{label}} AS sa_name FROM {{resources}} ORDER BY {{label}} LIMIT 100

$value.sql: SELECT * FROM {{table}} WHERE days_between(:today, {{start}}) >= 0 AND {{resource}} = :r LIMIT 3000

let.{{key}}_taken: =(data[{{key|json}}] || data[{{key|json}} + '_r'] || []).map(b => {{end|json}} && b[{{end|json}}] ? {start: b[{{start|json}}], end: b[{{end|json}}]} : b[{{start|json}}])
let.{{key}}_book: =s => { const v = {start: s.start, end: s.end, resource: state.{{key}}_r || null}; return {{view|json}} ? app.open({{view|json}}, v) : {{call|json}} ? app.call({{call|json}}, v).then(() => app.toast('Booked for ' + app.fmt.datetime(s.start))) : null; }

then.text: Pick one above to see the free times.
